articles.summary: Benzinga: Multimillionaires Were Asked If 'The Harder You Work, The Luckier You Get' Is True. 'You Can't Sink A Long Putt If You Aren't On The Green'. Someone recently posed a question to multimillionaires: Is the phrase “the harder you work, the luckier you get” actually true, or is building wealth mostly a matter of gambling and being in the right place at the right time? In Reddit’s r/RichPeoplePF thread, responses from multimillionaires pointed to an obvious takeaway: Luck matters, but those who work hard and position themselves strategically tend to have far more chances to benefit from it.
